'''Peckva''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[ungulate]]s [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to [[Maryo]], a resort [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]]. They were known for their speed and were [[Hunting/Legends|hunted]] by the rich who visited the world.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Peckva were first mentioned in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a reference book written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]] which was released in [[2009]].<ref name="TEA" />
